rationale: Evidence: iteration 7 raised kd from 1.2 to 1.8 (base 1.2, kp 3.5, ki 0, iteration-0 geometry) and became the first design to finish any run. Oval finished 14 of 20 trials at mean progress 0.97, scoring 774 on that track. The score rose from 56.9 to 340.5, so damping is the lever that matters. Two problems remain: s-bend reaches only 0.42 progress and slalom only 0.18, both ending off track. Oval steering oscillation rose to 0.33 from about 0.10, which shows that more damping is working but that the robot is still not stable through the sharper sections. The trend across kd 0.8, 1.2 and 1.8 is strongly positive, so this draft takes one further step: kd 1.8 to 2.5. I keep base_speed at 1.2, kp at 3.5 and ki at 0, and keep the geometry identical, so the race isolates the damping effect. I expect the s-bend and slalom progress to rise, with oval completion holding or improving. Oscillation will likely rise further, and a noise-driven jitter penalty is the main risk. If the slalom still ends early, the next step is to test line_loss 'search_right' or a further kd increase.
